title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Is VerHagen off the 40-man immediately? Or not until the 10-day period ends
He is off immediately, we are at 39

And just to clarify, because Lynn made some comment to Gerber about now his option year doesn't matter because he's already called up. That's not accurate, right? Say Gerber came up for eight games and went back down and never came up again
That would be nine games, under 20, so his option would remain in tact
Or, it is accurate, because Gerber would be down for more than 20 days
So if he stayed up the rest of the year, he'd keep an option. Shit is confusing
I don’t know what Lynn is talking about. I believe Gerber has been down for 17 days, so if he stayed for the rest of the season he would not burn an option
Lynn said that directly to Gerber?
"Well I think you've figured this out, too. Once they brought you up, your option year is now, that's no longer an issue, so it just makes it that much easier to come up."
1) I don’t know what that even means and 2) I wouldn’t talk to players about rules stuff especially if you don’t know the rule. Sorry thats just between us, obviously don’t repeat
I just remembered he said it so it made me think
